title: Vega
subtitle: Three stones. Three chapters. Diamond for clarity. Rubies for passion. The tension between them is the point.
description: At the center, a cushion-cut diamond — graded I/VS2 — built to catch light from every angle and hold it. Soft-cornered, brilliance-first, the kind of stone you notice before you understand why. Two rubies flank it, burning. This is a ring that doesn't whisper.
